description: Defines classes for stream adapters that wrap a SharedFD object to provide std::istream and std::ostream interfaces, including SharedFDStreambuf, SharedFDIstream, and SharedFDOstream.

classes.name: SharedFDStreambuf
classes.description: A custom stream buffer that adapts a SharedFD for use with C++ iostreams, handling reading and writing operations.

classes.name: SharedFDIstream
classes.description: An input stream class that uses SharedFDStreambuf to provide std::istream interface over a SharedFD.

classes.name: SharedFDOstream
classes.description: An output stream class that uses SharedFDStreambuf to provide std::ostream interface over a SharedFD.

methods.name: SharedFDStreambuf
methods.description: Constructor initializing the stream buffer with a SharedFD.

methods.name: SharedFDIstream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the input stream with a SharedFD.

methods.name: SharedFDOstream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the output stream with a SharedFD.
